content.text: This involves potential data loss (PVC lost, Postgres reinitialized an empty data directory). I shouldn't attempt a fix myself — restoring from backup requires human judgment.

input.reason: The orders-db-0 PVC (data-orders-db-0) is in Lost state, so the underlying PersistentVolume is gone. Postgres logs confirm it found an empty data directory and reinitialized ("database directory appears to contain no database; initializing"), meaning the orders table and all prior data are gone from the live volume. Recovery requires restoring from a database/volume backup and investigating why the PV was lost (likely a Delete reclaim policy on the dynamically provisioned PV, see docs on reclaim policies [cite: tasks/administer-cluster/change-pv-reclaim-policy#why-change-reclaim-policy-of-a-persistentvolume-0]). This is a data-loss incident that needs a human engineer with backup access.
